goal: Implement the smallest provider-neutral supervised production seam that takes an already-resolved exact operational Job_ID from Slice 1, consumes explicitly verified Employer Truth / deterministic upstream gate inputs, preserves the canonical gate order, invokes the existing frozen Match Truth analysis only after every required upstream gate permits it, and emits validated idempotent JOBS/LOG mutation plans that project those existing outcomes into the canonical Sheet fields. This milestone is wiring/projection only: it must not redesign Employer Truth, Candidate Truth, Match Truth, OPT semantics, gate semantics, job identity, pursuit approval, package generation, application submission, or provider credentials.
acceptance_conditions: Slice 2 accepts only a Slice-1-resolved exact operational Job_ID. The operational Job_ID remains the exact employer/system identity + exact requisition/opportunity identity created by Slice 1; src/job_id.py, company/title hashes, fuzzy title identity, discovery URL identity, and analysis-internal generated IDs may not replace or select that operational identity.

The existing analyze_job()/job_decision.py Match Truth core is reused unchanged. Slice 2 may call it and project its existing outputs, but may not modify its semantics, enums, thresholds, evidence matching, qualification logic, hard blockers, posting-state routing, or decision rules.

Analysis identity and operational identity remain distinct. Any Match Truth request/result is explicitly bound to the current operational exact-role Job_ID and current verified employer/JD input; a stale, mismatched, missing, or ambiguously bound analysis payload fails closed and cannot mutate that operational job.

Discovery nominations and source-provided claims remain untrusted. Posted-age labels, platform fit scores, sponsorship summaries, work-authorization summaries, location summaries, or other discovery claims may not satisfy Employer Truth, any cheap gate, first-party actionability, or Match Truth input requirements.

The provider-neutral Slice 2 input must carry explicit verified employer/source evidence sufficient for the existing Match Truth call, including current company/role, authoritative JD text, structured_extraction, official employer URL when available, role_status, source_verification_status, date_last_verified, and explicit upstream gate outcomes/provenance. Missing required verified input fails visibly rather than being guessed.

The canonical gate order from docs/SUPERVISED_PRODUCTION_V1.md is preserved: freshness -> geography -> employer exclusions/start horizon -> OPT/work-authorization screen -> candidate conditions -> threshold/seniority/specialist constraints -> actionability/conflicts -> crowding -> Match Truth. Slice 2 may consume already-established deterministic/verified gate outcomes, but it may not reorder, bypass, infer, or silently synthesize them.

Each required upstream gate is represented as an operational projection state only, never a new truth enum. A required gate may resolve only to PASS, HOLD, REJECT, or NOT_EVALUATED at the control-plane projection layer, with provenance/reason retained. These projection labels do not rewrite canonical Employer Truth, Candidate Truth, Match Truth, immigration/legal truth, or existing job enums.

Any upstream REJECT terminates before Match Truth and produces Pipeline_State=UPSTREAM_REJECTED. Any upstream HOLD, missing authoritative evidence, unresolved exact binding, or NOT_EVALUATED required gate terminates before Match Truth and produces Pipeline_State=VERIFICATION_REQUIRED. Match Truth must not run after either condition.

Only when every required upstream gate is PASS may Slice 2 invoke the existing Match Truth core. A valid existing analysis result is projected to the operational row without changing its decision/lane semantics; successful completion produces Pipeline_State=REVIEW_READY and makes the job eligible for Bora review, not automatic pursuit.

The JOBS mutation projection may populate only the doctrine fields needed by Slice 2: Official_URL, Last_Verified, Pipeline_State, Freshness_State, Geography_State, OPT_Screen_State, Candidate_Condition_State, Threshold_State, Role_Status, Match_State, and Decision, while preserving Slice 1 identity/source/first-seen fields. Bora_Decision, Package_Status, and Application_Status remain unset/unchanged.

Freshness_State, Geography_State, OPT_Screen_State, Candidate_Condition_State, and Threshold_State are operational projection fields with bounded control-plane states; Role_Status preserves the existing canonical role_status value verbatim; Decision preserves the existing analysis decision verbatim; Match_State records only whether Match Truth was NOT_REACHED, ANALYZED, or PROCESSING_ERROR and does not invent a fit score.
Official_URL and Employer Truth fields are populated only from explicit verified employer-side input. Discovery_URL may never be silently promoted to Official_URL.

LOG records include the operational Job_ID, stage, result, gate provenance/reason, analysis binding/provenance, Engine_Baseline, and visible error/hold information sufficient to reconstruct why Match Truth was or was not reached. No record silently disappears.

Slice 2 mutation planning is idempotent. Reprocessing the same verified employer/gate/analysis state cannot create duplicate logical JOBS rows or duplicate successful logical state; repeated evaluation may produce at most the deterministic mutation needed to converge the current row and an auditable non-duplicating run record under the existing ledger identity rules.

The production ledger mutation schema is extended only as needed to validate the doctrine JOBS/LOG fields and additional Slice 2 pipeline/log stages. It does not modify schemas/job.schema.json or schemas/job_analysis_result.schema.json.

No Google/Gmail credentials, OAuth secrets, account IDs, label IDs, spreadsheet IDs, or provider-specific user configuration is committed. Repository code emits deterministic mutation plans; supervised connected tools apply provider writes.
Slice 2 writes only JOBS and LOG. EVIDENCE, CLAIMS, APPLICATIONS, NETWORK, and SETTINGS remain untouched operationally in this milestone.

No PURSUE/Bora_Decision record is created or inferred. No package generation, Drive artifact persistence, application lifecycle persistence, auto-submit, Vercel UI/runtime, scheduling, Scout expansion, browser automation, or new database is implemented.

Existing exact-role identity, application-history dedupe, posting-state/actionability, recency, start-horizon, employer-exclusion, threshold, Match Truth, and Golden behavior remain unchanged and green.

A deterministic fixture/test matrix covers at minimum: all-upstream-PASS -> existing Match Truth -> REVIEW_READY projection; upstream REJECT -> no Match Truth; upstream HOLD/missing evidence -> no Match Truth; discovery-claim laundering attempt -> fail closed; stale/mismatched operational-to-analysis binding -> fail closed; official URL non-promotion; repeated run idempotency; valid WATCH/REJECT/APPLY-like existing decisions projected without reinterpretation.
No path outside allowed_paths changes.
All focused regressions, milestone/state, full canonical Assurance, Golden, and git diff --check pass on the exact immutable implementation candidate.

An independent adversarial reviewer evaluates the exact immutable implementation diff and returns SAFE, or every consequential finding is causally repaired and the mutated candidate is fully revalidated/refrozen before a new review.
stop_conditions: Implementation requires modifying src/job_analysis.py, src/job_decision.py, src/job_id.py, any qualification/evidence matcher, any existing Match Truth semantic, any Employer Truth semantic, any Candidate Truth semantic, or any protected schema.

Implementation requires inventing a new semantic gate because a required cheap-gate result is not already deterministically/authoritatively available. In that case stop and surface the missing gate rather than implementing speculative semantics inside Slice 2.
Implementation derives Employer Truth or a PASS/HOLD/REJECT gate result from a Gmail/discovery/platform claim without authoritative verification.

Implementation runs Match Truth when freshness, direct-source/actionability, geography, employer exclusion/start horizon, OPT/work-authorization, candidate conditions, threshold/seniority/specialist constraints, actionability/conflicts, or crowding is REJECT, HOLD, missing, unresolved, or NOT_EVALUATED.

Implementation uses analysis-internal generate_job_id(company, role), a company/title hash, fuzzy title, or URL as the operational exact-role Job_ID or permits an unbound analysis result to mutate an operational row.
Implementation promotes Discovery_URL to Official_URL without explicit employer-side verification.
Implementation changes a canonical job/analysis enum or reinterprets WATCH, REJECT, APPLY, EFFICIENT_APPLY, PRIORITY_APPLY, role_status, source_verification_status, or qualification results.
Implementation writes Bora_Decision, Package_Status, Application_Status, EVIDENCE, CLAIMS, APPLICATIONS, NETWORK, or SETTINGS operational state.

Implementation adds provider credentials/configuration, a hard-coded Sheet ID, direct Gmail/Sheets OAuth, Vercel deployment, scheduling, browser automation, Scout sources, package generation, application submission, or new database infrastructure.
Implementation requires any path outside allowed_paths.
Any historical Slice 1 exact-role/idempotency invariant, application-history/submitted-opportunity invariant, upstream gate regression, Match Truth regression, full Assurance, or Golden regresses.
Independent reviewer finds a consequential defect that cannot be repaired within this bounded wiring/projection seam.
review_requirements: MANDATORY_INDEPENDENT_EXACT_BYTE_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_BEFORE_COMMIT_PUSH; reviewer identity is replaceable, but reviewer independence and exact immutable candidate bytes are mandatory. Deterministic focused tests plus canonical milestone/state, full Assurance, Golden, and git diff --check are required after every implementation mutation that changes the frozen fingerprint.
